title: Trump praises 'reasonable guy' Hakeem Jeffries while touting 'ultimate' veto power over Democrats
summary: President Donald Trump says bipartisanship with Hakeem Jeffries could deliver "tremendous things," touting healthcare and a 10% credit card rate cap.

title: Zelenskyy says Russia strikes hometown, criticizes Putin-Trump meeting
summary: Zelenskyy says a Russian strike on his hometown Kryvyi Rih killed two people, including 7-year-old Tykhon, and wounded 58 others in a civilian area.

title: Maher calls out 'spoiled brats' who left US over Trump presidency, says country ‘self-corrected’ in midterms
summary: Bill Maher mocked the "spoiled brats" who fled to England or Ireland over Trump, questioning the patriotism of stars who left after losing elections.

title: Voters want to 'move on' from the president, former Trump official claims as reason for GOP's midterm defeat
summary: Former Kansas Republican Sen. Sam Brownback says voters rejected President Trump himself, not his policies, citing inflation and gas prices.

title: Trump says Sen Cornyn is doing a 'tremendous disservice' by blocking Texas judicial pick
summary: President Donald Trump says Sen. John Cornyn is doing a "tremendous disservice" by blocking DOJ lawyer Elliot Gaiser's federal judge nomination in Dallas.

title: Mike Waltz warns Kremlin faces 'unsustainable' losses approaching WWII scale as Trump seeks deal
summary: United Nations Ambassador Mike Waltz says Russia is losing up to 35,000 troops a month in Ukraine, calling the battlefield losses "unsustainable."

title: Trump says Vance, Rubio are 'doing fantastically' ahead of 2028 Republican presidential primary
summary: Donald Trump says JD Vance and Marco Rubio are "doing fantastically" and "both very, very popular" as the 2028 Republican primary field takes shape.

title: Top Trump officials' holiday emails to staff calling Jesus 'our Savior' went 'too far,' judge rules
summary: Judge Trina Thompson blocked Brooke Rollins from sharing religious messaging, ruling her USDA Christmas and Easter emails were coercive to employees.

title: Trump orders federal contractors to alert White House on congressional record requests
summary: President Donald Trump's executive order tells federal contractors to withhold material deemed privileged, risking contract loss as Democrats ready probes.

title: Trump floats an unexpected name to be his successor as powerhouses Rubio and Vance stand by
summary: Donald Trump stunned the White House press briefing room by asking Stephen Miller if he wants to run for president, as JD Vance and Marco Rubio looked on.
